newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: UAE to grant Pakistan $500 mln loan - govt official.
newsitem.headline: UAE to grant Pakistan $500 mln loan - govt official.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates has decided to provide Pakistan with a concessional loan of $500 million, a government official said on Monday.
"It is a gesture on the part of the UAE government that they are behind Pakistan," Hafeez Pasha, deputy chairman of the Planning Commission, told Reuters.
Pasha said the loan would carry an interest rate "significantly below" market levels, but said the details, including the maturity of the loan, had not yet been completed.
"We are hoping that our conventional sources (of financing) will now disburse faster after this," he said, adding that the UAE loan was likely to be available very soon.

Pakistan's caretaker government, aiming to rebuild foreign reserves to more than $1 billion by the end of 1996, is hoping to receive at least $160 million from the International Monetary Fund by mid-December, representing two delayed tranches of a standby loan that began to be disbursed a year ago.
Foreign reserves, excluding gold and special drawing rights, stood at $690 million on November 21, according to the central bank.
